# BuildAI Reviews

> AI website builder comparisons published by The Tech GUY. First-hand experience and research-based assessments are labelled separately; current plan details should be confirmed with providers.

## Rankings & Reviews
- [Best AI Website Builders in 2026 — Reviews & Comparisons](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/): A comparison of five AI builders, with evidence limitations and use-case trade-offs explained.
- [Durable AI Review (9.1/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/durable/): First-hand client-project experience: Durable handled much of the initial build and the client was happy. Observed traffic is not attributed to Durable without analytics evidence.
- [Dorik AI Review (8.6/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/dorik/): Research-based assessment: check current design controls, agency features, language support and plan restrictions with Dorik.
- [Framer Review (8.3/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/framer/): Research-based assessment: compare Framer’s design workflow, interactions, publishing and current free/paid plan limits.
- [Wix AI Review (7.8/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/wix/): Research-based assessment: verify Wix feature availability, apps, commerce, bookings and SEO controls on current plans.
- [10Web Review (7.4/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/10web/): Research-based assessment: verify WordPress creation, hosting, performance tools and maintenance responsibilities.

## Comparisons
- [Durable vs Dorik vs Framer](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/compare/durable-vs-dorik-vs-framer/): A comparison of Durable, Dorik and Framer with feature and use-case trade-offs.
- [Durable vs Dorik](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/compare/durable-vs-dorik/): Speed vs design control.
- [Durable vs Framer](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/compare/durable-vs-framer/): Done-for-you speed vs total creative control.
- [Dorik vs Framer](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/compare/dorik-vs-framer/): AI-assisted design vs pixel-perfect power.
